The '''Google Pixel 4a (5G)''' (codename '''google-bramble''') is a mid-range smartphone manufactured by Google and released in November 2020. It is based on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 765G (SM7250) platform.

== Contributors ==
* Yurii Bishchuk (astellias) - downstream bring-up, Phosh & touchscreen fixes, DRM interceptor
* SniverDaBest - initial device package exploration
* WeirdTreeThing - mainline SM7250 work

== Status ==
A fully graphical postmarketOS environment ('''Phosh''', '''Phoc''', '''Squeekboard''') and '''Weston''' is operational on the physical OLED display with working 10-point multi-touch input.

|-

== How to enter flash mode ==
# Turn off the phone completely.
# Hold '''Volume Down''' and '''Power''' simultaneously until the Google fastboot/bootloader screen appears.

== Installation ==

=== 1. Configure pmbootstrap ===
Select the device and your preferred mobile interface:
<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
pmbootstrap init
# Target device: google-bramble
# User interface: phosh (or weston)
# Kernel: downstream
</syntaxhighlight>

=== 2. Build and Install Rootfs ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
pmbootstrap install
</syntaxhighlight>

=== 3. Tethered Boot (Non-destructive) ===
You can safely test the postmarketOS build tethered from RAM without overwriting your phone's Android partitions:
<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
pmbootstrap flasher boot
</syntaxhighlight>

== Hardware Details & Fixes ==

=== 1. Qualcomm MSM DRM Duplicate FourCC Crash ===
The downstream Qualcomm `msm_drm` driver reports duplicate `DRM_FORMAT_ARGB8888` (`AB24`) formats in plane format lists. Modern Wayland compositors (wlroots, Phoc, Weston) assert against duplicate formats and abort during startup.
* '''Fix:''' `device-google-bramble` provides `/usr/lib/libfix_drm_formats.so`, which deduplicates pixel formats, promotes Plane 77 to `DRM_PLANE_TYPE_PRIMARY`, and enforces monotonic vblank event timestamps.

=== 2. Touchscreen Event Classification ===
The FocalTech touch controller driver declares wake-up gesture keys (`KEY_W`, `KEY_E`), which causes `libinput` to misidentify the device as a keyboard instead of a touchscreen.
* '''Fix:''' A dedicated udev rule (`/usr/lib/udev/rules.d/90-google-bramble.rules`) and dynamic udev properties tag `/dev/input/event2` with `ID_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN=1` and bind it to `WL_OUTPUT=DSI-1`.

=== 3. Linux Kernel 4.19 `faccessat` Emulation ===
Modern GLib/GIO invokes `faccessat(AT_FDCWD, path, F_OK, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW)`. Downstream Android kernel 4.19 lacks `faccessat2` (sys_439), returning `-EINVAL`, which previously caused GLib to report that all `.desktop` files, icons, and themes did not exist.
* '''Fix:''' `libfix_drm_formats.so` intercepts `faccessat` and translates flags on kernel 4.19 to `fstatat(..., AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW)`.

=== 4. POSIX Shared Memory ===
Wayland keymap allocation (`allocate_shm_file`) requires POSIX shared memory. `/dev/shm` is automatically mounted as `tmpfs` with mode `1777` during early boot.
